# UI Pirate — SaaS & AI Product Design & Development Agency
<!-- Last updated: 2026-10-09 -->

> UI Pirate is a product design and development agency founded by Vishal Anand in 2022. We help SaaS founders, enterprise teams, and AI product teams think through the product, design it for real users, and ship production-ready code — from first wireframe to deployed product, with the same team start to finish. Stack: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, AWS/GCP/Azure, and AI agents / LLM APIs. Clients are mostly in the USA, UK, and Singapore.

## What Makes Us Different

We are NOT just a design studio that creates static screens. Our approach: **have a conversation about your product — we carry the rest.** From a few lines of your vision, we help you:

- **Think through your product** — product thinking, competitive analysis, market positioning
- **Plan the architecture** — information architecture, user flows, database & API design
- **Design the experience** — UX research, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototypes
- **Build the software** — production-ready front end and full-stack development
- **Ship and scale** — cloud deployment, performance, design-system handoff, ongoing support

We specialize in complex SaaS and AI products: multi-role dashboards, data-heavy interfaces, backend workflows, API integrations, and real business logic. We also take AI-generated prototypes (Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Claude Code) and rebuild them into secure, scalable, production-grade products.

## About

- **Founder**: Vishal Anand — 9+ years of personal experience in product design & software development (before and since founding UI Pirate in 2022)
- **Founded**: 2022
- **Team**: 7 people — Vishal Anand (Founder & Lead Designer), Danish Ansari (Lead Frontend Developer), Syed Musaddiq (Lead UX Designer), Kartik Kumar (Lead Graphics & Motion), Aniket (Lead Backend & AI Developer), Priyagni (Graphic Designer), Aman (Video Editing)
- **Based in**: India, remote-first; about 60% of clients are US-based; overlap with US Eastern and Pacific hours
- **Track record**: 50+ products shipped, 5.0 client rating
- **Core technologies**: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer, Figma, GSAP, Node.js, Python, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, AI agents / LLM APIs

## Services (4)

1. **UX/UI Design** — SaaS, AI & mobile app design: discovery and strategy, information architecture, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototypes, and production-ready UI development in React, Next.js, or Angular. New build or redesign. Typical timeline: 1–2 months. https://uipirate.com/services/UX-UI-Design
2. **SaaS & AI Development** — full-stack engineering: backend, database and APIs on Node.js or Python, LLM integrations, AI agents and RAG pipelines, payments/auth, cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, Azure) with CI/CD. Includes turning AI-generated prototypes into production code. https://uipirate.com/services/SaaS-&-AI-Development
3. **Landing Pages & Business Websites** — conversion-focused marketing sites built in React, Next.js, Framer, or Webflow; SEO- and AI-search-readable; fully responsive. Typical timeline: 2–4 weeks. https://uipirate.com/services/Landing-Pages-&-Business-Websites
4. **UX Audits & Consultation** — heuristic UX audit report, drop-off and friction insights, flow review, prioritised findings, optional walkthrough video, and an action roadmap. Most audits take 1–2 weeks. https://uipirate.com/services/UX-Audits-&-Consultation

Design systems and component libraries are delivered as part of UX/UI Design and SaaS builds (there is no standalone service page).

## Pricing

- **Monthly retainer**: from $499/month — 1 active request at a time, weekly progress sync, fast turnaround, Mon–Fri with under 2-hour response. No long-term contract; can be paused.
- **Custom project quote**: from $2,000 — scoped to the project.
- **5-Day Pilot**: a small paid pilot ($150–$350) with real deliverables; the fee is deducted from the final invoice if you continue.
- Details: https://uipirate.com/pricing

## Our Approach

1. **Listen** — you share the vision, even if it's a few lines
2. **Think** — competitive analysis and product research
3. **Plan** — user flows, information architecture, feature prioritisation
4. **Design** — wireframes → high-fidelity UI → interactive prototypes
5. **Build** — production-ready React, Angular, or Next.js, plus backend and API integration
6. **Ship & Scale** — deployment, design-system handoff, ongoing support

More: https://uipirate.com/process

Index: https://uipirate.com/case-studies

- **NxVoy** — AI travel assistant (Sasha) that replaces flight search forms with conversation without losing power users: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/nxvoy-ai-flight-booking-ux-case-study
- **ConnectWise / IFTA** — unified communication ecosystem that streamlines support operations and event networking for members: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/designing-connectwise-how-we-solved-complex-operations-and-event-engagement-in-one-ecosystem

- **Legacy enterprise software redesign** — simplified 20 years of system complexity and configuration without breaking a successful product: https://uipirate.com/case-studies/how-to-redesign-legacy-enterprise-software-without-breaking-what-works---a-case-study

## Not a Fit For

Physical product design, logo-only or print projects, and one-off stock-template sites. For those we recommend other partners.
